proposed.text: According to RA 9266 IRR Section 3(4), how many lettered service categories (a through j) are listed under the scope of the practice of architecture?

rationale.a: Seven categories understates the IRR enumeration; the IRR lists ten lettered categories (a)-(j).
rationale.b: Nine categories understates the IRR enumeration; a tenth catch-all category (j) covers all other works requiring architectural competence.
rationale.d: Twelve categories exceeds the IRR enumeration; only ten lettered categories (a)-(j) appear in Section 3(4).
rationale.correct: RA 9266 IRR Section 3(4) enumerates ten lettered service categories: (a) planning; (b) consultation; (c) appraisal; (d) structural conceptualization; (e) architectural interiors; (f) site development and utility layouting; (g) building administration; (h) construction supervision; (i) project management; and (j) all other works, projects, and activities requiring the professional competence of an architect.
rationale.takeaway: The ten categories (a)-(j) define the statutory boundaries of architectural scope, with the catch-all (j) allowing the PRBoA to recognize emerging services without statutory amendment.
